stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Erik tells Raven to be proud of her true blue form, and she leaves with him after Cuba.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Leaves with Erik as Mystique.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Raven to be proud of how she looks.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Mystique is Magneto's most loyal lieutenant, a spy who can wear any face for his plans.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Magneto's most loyal lieutenant.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The leader Mystique serves.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: When Mystique takes a cure dart meant for Magneto and loses her powers, he abandons her. She tells the government where to find him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Takes a cure dart meant for Magneto, and he abandons her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Abandons Mystique, and she betrays him.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 1973 Erik tries to kill Raven in Paris, believing her death will stop the Sentinels. Later, in Washington, she brings him down with a plastic gun.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Shot at by Erik in Paris. Stops him in Washington with a plastic gun.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tries to kill Raven in Paris. She stops him in Washington.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Mystique poisons a guard with iron so Magneto can break out of his plastic prison. Together they turn Stryker's Cerebro on humans and escape in his helicopter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Frees Magneto from his plastic prison.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The leader Mystique breaks out of prison.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Mystique injects guard Laurio with iron, which Magneto pulls out to escape; at Alkali Lake Magneto reconfigures Cerebro and Mystique, as Stryker, has Jason target humans; they take Stryker's helicopter.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps Rogue and uses her power to run his machine, though it may kill her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The girl Magneto uses to power his machine.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Kidnaps Rogue to power his machine.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: On the flight to Alkali Lake, Magneto taunts Rogue about the white streak in her hair, a reminder of how he nearly killed her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Taunted by Magneto over the streak in her hair.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Taunts Rogue about the night he nearly killed her.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: 'Magneto taunts Rogue about the white streaks in her hair, reminding her of their first encounter when he'd almost killed her.'

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Years ago Magneto and Xavier visited Jean as a girl. Now he recruits the Phoenix, and she stands with him at Alcatraz.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Recruited to Magneto's side as the Phoenix.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Welcomes Jean's power.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Jean reads Nightcrawler's mind to find Stryker's base for Magneto's plan, then goes in with him to keep an eye on him and holds off a brainwashed Cyclops so he can reach Cerebro.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Magneto's raid to keep an eye on him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Works with Jean to stop Stryker.

their_evidence: Fandom plot: Magneto needs Jean to read Nightcrawler's mind for the base location; 'Jean Grey joins Magneto and Mystique in order to keep an eye on them' and fights Cyclops 'to buy Magneto enough time to get to Dark Cerebro'.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Inside the Statue of Liberty, Magneto pins the X-Men to the walls while Sabretooth pulls off Scott's visor. Once Logan breaks free and distracts him, Scott blasts Magneto down so Logan can wreck the machine.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Scott blasts him down at Liberty Island.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Blasts Magneto down at Liberty Island.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Inside the Alkali Lake dam, a brainwashed Scott aims a blast at Magneto and Mystique from a crossing hallway. Jean shoves them clear and tells them to go, and Magneto leaves her to fight Scott.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Scott, under Stryker's control, aims a blast at him in the dam.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Aims a blast at Magneto in the dam while under Stryker's control.

their_evidence: X2: at Stryker's Alkali Lake base, the mind-controlled Cyclops prepares to shoot at Magneto and Mystique; Jean telekinetically shoves them out of the way and tells them to go, and Magneto calls it a lovers' quarrel they cannot get involved in. (Earlier Scott only waits outside the plastic prison while Xavier questions Magneto, so the dam is the moment between them.)

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#11
stages.text: Daisy Johnson helps catch Elena Rodriguez in Bogotá, then fights beside her to rescue Bobbi and Hunter, and Elena agrees to join Daisy's Secret Warriors.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman who joins Daisy's Secret Warriors.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Inhuman whose Secret Warriors Elena joins.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#6
proposed.text: After Daisy saves her in Baltimore, Yo-Yo backs her story, and together they erase every record of Yo-Yo's trip from S.H.I.E.L.D.'s system. Yo-Yo tells Daisy she did not kill Ramon and gives her Peggy Carter's old pin as a reminder that she is part of the team.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman who keeps Daisy's secret and gives her Peggy Carter's pin.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Inhuman who saves Yo-Yo in Baltimore and helps erase her trip.

their_evidence: Slingshot#5 (Deal Breaker): Quake frees the captive Yo-Yo and holds off the Watchdogs. Slingshot#6 (Justicia): Yo-Yo offers to help the fugitive Daisy, who declines; in the present the two delete all record of Yo-Yo in Baltimore from Mace's office, and Yo-Yo tells her she did not kill Ramon and gives her Peggy Carter's old badge, as Coulson did for her. Slingshot#1 (Vendetta) opens with them agreeing to get their story straight for Mace.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
stages.text: After Lincoln is locked up as Hive's suspected spy, Yo-Yo gives Jemma blood samples to test for Hive's infection, then demands to be let go from S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who tests Yo-Yo's blood for Hive's infection.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Secret Warrior who gives Jemma blood samples, then walks out on S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#15
stages.text: After Ruby Hale cuts off Yo-Yo's arms, Jemma looks after her through her recovery and is the one who fits her with new bionic arms.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who nurses Yo-Yo and fits her with new bionic arms.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend whose arms Ruby cuts off. Jemma nurses her and fits her with bionics.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#3
proposed.text: Jemma checks Yo-Yo's pulse while finishing her Inhuman registration, and Yo-Yo knocks over lab equipment and talks up apartment hunting to keep her from seeing the search on the lab computer.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who registers Yo-Yo, kept from seeing her search.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Inhuman Jemma registers, who distracts her to hide a search for Ramon.

their_evidence: Slingshot#3 (Progress): Simmons and Fitz complete Yo-Yo's Inhuman registration; Simmons checks her pulse, Yo-Yo knocks over equipment to distract them and suggests they look for an apartment, and Simmons leaves.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#3
stages.text: Yo-Yo helps Fitz track down the Watchdogs' blackout device, and Fitz, Coulson and Mack save her from a Watchdog execution.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend Yo-Yo helps hunt the blackout device. Helps save her from a Watchdog execution.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who helps Fitz hunt the Watchdogs' device, and whom he helps rescue.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#16
stages.text: Wearing the new arms Fitz built her, Yo-Yo helps Simmons trick Mack into letting Fitz out of his cell, then locks Mack in it and leaves with the pair to hunt Hydra's weapon.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who builds Yo-Yo new arms. She helps break him out of his cell.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend Fitz builds new arms for, who helps break him out of his cell.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#3
proposed.text: Fitz upgrades Yo-Yo's watch so S.H.I.E.L.D. can monitor her powers and scolds her for getting Jemma hooked on apartment hunting, unaware she is using the lab computer to find Ramon.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Engineer who upgrades Yo-Yo's watch to monitor her powers.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Inhuman whose watch Fitz upgrades, who hides a search from him.

their_evidence: Slingshot#3 (Progress): Fitz upgrades Yo-Yo's watch, chastises her for making Simmons obsessed with an apartment, and tells her the watch lets S.H.I.E.L.D. monitor her powers; after he leaves she finds Ramon is in Baltimore.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#20
stages.text: Melinda May looks out for Yo-Yo after she joins Coulson's team.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who looks out for Yo-Yo on Coulson's team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend May looks out for on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#3
stages.text: When the team lands in 1955, May and Yo-Yo pose as pilots and storm a lab at Area 51 to flush out a Chronicom spy.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who storms Area 51 with Yo-Yo.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend May storms Area 51 with.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
stages.text: May takes Yo-Yo to Afterlife to seek Jiaying's help, then talks her through the block until she wins back her powers.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who takes Yo-Yo to Afterlife and helps her win back her powers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend May takes to Afterlife and helps win back her powers.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#4
proposed.text: May works out that Yo-Yo stole Mace's lanyard, takes it back and scolds her for sloppy spy work, then keeps quiet and quietly sends her Quinjet to Baltimore.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who catches Yo-Yo's theft, keeps quiet and sends her to Baltimore.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friend May catches stealing Mace's lanyard and quietly sends to Baltimore.

their_evidence: Slingshot#3 (Progress): May hints she knows who stole Mace's lanyard. Slingshot#4 (Reunion): on the Quinjet May takes the lanyard back, warns her about sloppy spy work, promises not to tell S.H.I.E.L.D., and the pilot says he is taking her to Baltimore instead of Los Angeles; May grins and nods.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#20
stages.text: Coulson welcomes Yo-Yo back to S.H.I.E.L.D. and has her show off her speed to General Talbot, to prove why the Secret Warriors must stay secret.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The director who welcomes Yo-Yo back and has her show her speed to Talbot.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman Coulson has show her speed to Talbot.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#3
stages.text: Phil Coulson leads the rescue when a Watchdog squad is about to execute Yo-Yo.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who rescues Yo-Yo from a Watchdog execution.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend Coulson rescues from a Watchdog execution.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#10
stages.text: Yo-Yo learns from her future self that saving Coulson could doom the Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend whose rescue, Yo-Yo learns, could doom the Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who learns that saving Coulson could doom the Earth.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
stages.text: Coulson heeds Yo-Yo's warning and refuses the serum that could save him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Friend whose rescue could doom Earth. Heeds Yo-Yo's warning.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who warns Coulson that saving him could doom the Earth.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#1
proposed.text: On his way out after stepping down as Director, Coulson urges Yo-Yo to give Mace a chance and gives her a pin that belonged to Peggy Carter, so she remembers she is part of a team.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who gives Yo-Yo Peggy Carter's pin before leaving to find Daisy.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friend Coulson gives Peggy Carter's pin, to remind her she is part of a team.

their_evidence: Slingshot#1 (Vendetta): Coulson enters with his belongings after stepping down, talks with Yo-Yo about the changes under Mace, advises her to give Mace a chance and gifts her a pin that belonged to Peggy Carter so she remembers she is part of a team; both hope he will find Daisy.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: When Cosmo strains to hold two ships together so the rescued children can cross to Knowhere, Mantis uses her powers to give her more strength.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian who lends Cosmo strength to hold the ships together.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The dog Mantis empowers to hold two ships together for the children.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Cosmo helps the people of Knowhere decorate for the surprise Christmas party that Mantis throws for Quill.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian whose Christmas party for Quill Cosmo helps decorate.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A new teammate who helps decorate for her Christmas party for Quill.

their_evidence: Cosmo, with the other inhabitants of Knowhere, helps Mantis and Drax decorate the base to cheer up Quill; Mantis tells Kraglin she wants to throw the party.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leaves Cosmo and Kraglin to guard Knowhere while the Guardians go to save Rocket. She later links the two ships so Quill can bring the rescued children home.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardians' leader, who leaves Cosmo to guard Knowhere.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Quill leaves to guard Knowhere, who links the ships for the children.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Cosmo is one of the team on Knowhere who decorate the base and throw Quill a surprise Christmas party.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardians' leader, whose surprise Christmas party Cosmo helps decorate.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A new member of the team who helps decorate for Quill's Christmas party.

their_evidence: Cosmo helps decorate Knowhere to cheer up Quill and is at the celebration (gives Kraglin an Orloni). Rests on the shared party scene only.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Groot break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. When the regrown Groot dances behind Drax's back, he freezes every time Drax looks his way.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Baby Groot freezes whenever Drax looks.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Groot dances behind his back.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: At the Christmas party on Knowhere, Groot gives Drax a wood carving of him flipping a police car, and Drax laughs.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who carves Drax flipping a police car as a Christmas gift.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who laughs at Groot's carving of him flipping a police car.

their_evidence: During the celebration Groot gives Drax a wood carving of him flipping the police car, making him laugh.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis bonds with Drax on Ego's planet and reveals Ego's true plan to him. The two become best friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's best friend. Reveals Ego's plan to him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Mantis's best friend. They bond on Ego's planet.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Mantis confides in Drax that she wants to give Quill a perfect Christmas gift, and the two fly to Earth together to kidnap Kevin Bacon for him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who flies to Earth with Drax to kidnap Kevin Bacon for Quill.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who flies to Earth with Mantis to kidnap Kevin Bacon for Quill.

their_evidence: Mantis discusses with Drax her plan to find a perfect present for Quill; they go to Hollywood and take Bacon back to Knowhere.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is Yondu's first mate, and the Ravagers team up with the Guardians against Ronan. When Drax calls the Sakaarans paper people, Kraglin likes it so much he punches him on the shoulder.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Yondu's first mate, who fights beside Drax and the Guardians against Ronan.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian whose paper people line Kraglin loves.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Kraglin is now a member of the Guardians, and he flies with Drax and the team on their missions across the galaxy.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian now, flying with Drax on the team's missions.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian on the team that welcomes Kraglin.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Kraglin tells Drax and the others how Yondu once ruined Christmas for young Quill.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian who tells Drax how Yondu ruined Quill's Christmas.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian who hears Kraglin's story of Quill's ruined Christmas.

their_evidence: Drax notices Quill acting strange; Kraglin explains Christmas is coming, a holiday Yondu ruined for Quill. Opening scene has Nebula, Drax, Kraglin and Mantis together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nebula hunts Drax's friends across Knowhere on Ronan's orders. On the Dark Aster, Drax blasts her with a rocket launcher.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ronan's ally. Drax blasts her on the Dark Aster.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of the heroes who blasts Nebula on the Dark Aster.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula comes to Ego's planet to kill Gamora, but Mantis warns her, Drax and Gamora of Ego's plan together, and Nebula fights alongside the Guardians against him. She then leaves to hunt Thanos.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister. Fights beside Drax against Ego, then leaves.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Nebula fights beside against Ego.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Nebula and Drax are both Guardians now, and after the High Evolutionary is defeated they leave the team together to raise the rescued children on Knowhere.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian. Leaves the team with Drax to raise the children.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian. Leaves the team with Nebula to raise the children.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Drax and Nebula hear Kraglin's story of Quill's ruined Christmas together, and both are there when the team surprises Quill with a Christmas party on Knowhere.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.

their_evidence: Kraglin tells the story to Mantis, Drax and Nebula; both take part in the party. No direct exchange sourced; rests on shared scenes.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Quill first meet as inmates in the Kyln and become founding Guardians. Drax looks out for Quill like a brother.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Drax looks out for him like a brother.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Looks out for Quill like a brother.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Drax helps Mantis kidnap Kevin Bacon as Quill's Christmas present, and Quill is horrified to find his hero gift-wrapped for him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The friend Drax kidnaps Kevin Bacon for as a Christmas present.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who helps kidnap Kevin Bacon as Quill's Christmas present.

their_evidence: Drax suggests and helps carry out the kidnapping of Bacon as Quill's present; Quill is horrified and Drax insists Bacon is great.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Drax break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. They trade insults constantly but fight side by side.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After years together, Drax leaves the team in Rocket's hands.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's longtime teammate, left in charge of the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's longtime teammate. Leaves the team in Rocket's hands.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Drax and Rocket are both on Knowhere when the team surprises Quill with a Christmas party and a kidnapped Kevin Bacon.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party.

their_evidence: Both are at the party reveal and celebration on Knowhere. No direct exchange sourced; rests on the shared party scene.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula tricks the young Groot into freeing her from her restraints, then joins Taserface's mutiny. She later comes around and fights alongside Groot against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Captive who tricks Groot into freeing her, then fights beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian Nebula tricks into freeing her, then fights beside against Ego.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: At the Christmas party on Knowhere, Groot gives Nebula a wood carving he made of her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who gets one of Groot's wood carvings for Christmas.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who gives Nebula a wood carving for Christmas.

their_evidence: Groot gives Nebula a gift; she opens it to find a wood carving of herself at the party.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Groot and Rocket first try to cash in on the bounty on Peter Quill, then team up with him as founding Guardians. Groot sacrifices himself to save the team.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bounty turned fellow founding Guardian, whom Groot gives his life to save.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Bounty hunter turned founding Guardian, who sacrifices himself for the team.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Groot wheels out the gift-wrapped Kevin Bacon for Quill, then claims he thought it was a bad idea. Later Quill gives Groot a Game Boy, and Groot gives him a carving of the kidnapping.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who gives Groot a Game Boy for Christmas.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who wheels out Quill's surprise gift and gives him a carving.

their_evidence: Groot carts out the present; Quill calls him out for saying it was a bad idea; Quill gives Groot a GameBoy and Groot gives Quill a carving of Drax and Mantis kidnapping Bacon.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Taserface's mutiny, Kraglin fits Nebula with a new cybernetic hand and gives her a ship so she can hunt down Gamora on Ego's planet.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister, whom Kraglin fits with a hand and a ship.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who gives Nebula a new hand and a ship to hunt Gamora.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: When Kraglin brings up Christmas, Nebula says they have no time for it while they rebuild Knowhere, and the two go back to the repairs.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian who brushes off Christmas to keep rebuilding Knowhere.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian whose talk of Christmas Nebula brushes off.

their_evidence: Kraglin says Christmas is coming by the Multi-Calendar; Nebula says they have too much on their plate rebuilding Knowhere; Obfonteri and Nebula return to repair work.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is a Ravager on the crew of Yondu Udonta, who raised Quill, and he flies with the Ravagers beside the Guardians at the Battle of Xandar.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The boy Yondu raised, whom Kraglin flies beside at Xandar.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager from the crew that raised Peter.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Yondu's death, Kraglin joins the Guardians and becomes Quill's friend.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kraglin's friend and new teammate.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A new Guardian and friend after Yondu's death.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Kraglin remembers young Quill teaching him about Christmas aboard the Ravager ship. When the team kidnaps Kevin Bacon, Quill has Kraglin ready the ship to take him home, and Kraglin tells Bacon how much he means to Quill.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The boy who taught Kraglin Christmas, now a friend who sends him to fly Bacon home.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An old Ravager friend who helped him celebrate Christmas as a boy.

their_evidence: Animated flashback: Quill shows Kraglin Christmas and they make a tree; present day Quill orders Kraglin to prepare the Bowie, and Kraglin tells Bacon about Quill.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: During Taserface's mutiny, Kraglin helps Rocket and Yondu break free and retake the ship.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardian Kraglin helps break free from Taserface.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who helps Rocket and Yondu retake the ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Years later, Kraglin is part of the new Guardians team that Rocket leads.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kraglin's leader on the new Guardians.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian on the team Rocket leads.

proposed.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
proposed.text: Kraglin and Rocket are fellow Guardians on Knowhere, and both are there when the team surprises Quill with a Christmas party.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.
